snippet.title: ESPN International Track & Field (Game Boy Color) - Longplay
snippet.description:
Back in the 90's, ESPN had its license used for a bunch of sports titles. Most of the time the results were less than stellar, but International Track & Field is pretty good! Unfortunately, I'm sure if you were to ask ESPN they woulda hoped that the football/baseball/hockey games were good instead, but nope. Konami definitely knew how to make an olympic sports game. Come to think of it, I'm not sure what the market even was for all these olympic sports games. Most kids I knew were fine with just the original NES game...
